svg.data-renderer: Matplotlib MathText / STIX; embedded vector paths
svg.title: Infinite ordinal order types
svg.desc: Rows show one increasing omega sequence, two successive copies, omega many copies, and the supremum of the finite powers of omega.

Figure labels: ω; ω + ω; ω · ω; ωω; 0 < 1 < 2 < 3 < ···; 0 < 1 < 2 < ···; ω < ω+1 < ω+2 < ···; • • • ···; • • • ···; • • • ···; ···; 1 < ω < ω² < ω³ < ···; supremum of these order types; first copy of ω; second copy of ω; ω; ω; ω
